scripts.text: ^FF0000-Warning Message-
- Wait for a minute !! -
- You have too many items -
- Not able to receive items. -
- Reduce the weight of body -
- Please try again. -^000000
[Gelkah]
Show me proof that you're part of the Eden Group or I have no business with you.
scripts.translation: 请证明你是乐园团成员，否则我没必要和你谈。

scripts.text: I'm giving requests to base level ^FF0000100 - 110^000000 adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我为基础等级^FF0000100～110^000000的冒险者发布委托。

scripts.text: You're not a mature enough adventurer. You should be at least base level 100. So basically at least a third class.
scripts.translation: 你还不够成熟，至少要达到基础等级100级，也就是至少三转。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
The request is from ^FF0000somewhere else^000000 other than Midgard.
scripts.translation: 这份委托来自^FF0000米德加尔特以外的某个地方^000000。

scripts.text: Adventurers!
[Gelkah]
I've recently received several requests from clients that need the help of Adventurers just like yourself.
scripts.translation: 最近我收到了好几份委托，委托人需要像你这样的冒险者帮忙。

scripts.text: I like requests!
A boring quest... No thanks!
[Gelkah]
You know that harder requests yield better rewards right?
scripts.translation: 你知道越难的委托，报酬越丰厚吧？

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Actually, I can't just accept just any schmo off the street. My Master hates indecisive people.
scripts.translation: 其实我不能随便找个路人就接受委托。我的师父最讨厌优柔寡断的人。

scripts.text: Who's your master?
I am not indecisive!
[Gelkah]
That person standing next to me is my master... He came back after long journey of practice.
scripts.translation: 我旁边那位就是我的师父...他结束了漫长的修行，最近才回来。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
I understand you might	wonder why a Sura wants an Archbishop as a teacher...
scripts.translation: 你可能会奇怪，为什么一名修罗会拜大主教为师...

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
You think you're a veteran just because you've become a third class...
scripts.translation: 你不会以为转职成三转职业，就算是老练的冒险者了吧...

scripts.text: I know you're not exactly a novice but my Master thinks you're no different from one. In my opinion, You are a great adventurer!
scripts.translation: 虽然你不算新手，但师父觉得你和新手没两样。不过我认为你是位了不起的冒险者！

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
We need adventurers that are willing to help. Will you help us?
scripts.translation: 我们需要愿意帮忙的冒险者。你愿意助我们一臂之力吗？

scripts.text: Ok, I'll help.
I have no interest in helping you.
[Gelkah]
How do you know without doing it.
[Gelkah]
That is what an Adventurer does!
scripts.translation: 这才是冒险者该做的事！

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
I would like to know if you are capable of doing a request. Let me see...
scripts.translation: 我想确认你有没有能力完成委托。让我看看...

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Collect 50 ^ff0000Brigan.^000000 It is a simple and complicated test.
scripts.translation: 收集50个^ff0000布里刊。^000000这项测试说简单也简单，说难也难。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
It is easy to find from monsters at Turtle Island or at Glastheim.
scripts.translation: 在海底洞穴岛或格拉斯特海姆都能轻松找到。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Lets do the real request after clearing the simple one.
scripts.translation: 通过简单的测试后，我们再开始真正的委托。

scripts.text: Did you bring all the Brigans I asked for?
scripts.translation: 你把我要的布里刊都带来了吗？

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
I do not need to count one by one. This request is for selecting the best adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我不用一个个清点。这项测试是为了选出最优秀的冒险者。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Don't be upset because Master is ultimately responsible if an Adventurer gets injured during a request.
scripts.translation: 别不高兴，冒险者在委托中受伤，最终要由师父负责。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Master decided that adventurer's safety is important because lots of new requests are dangerous.
scripts.translation: 师父认为冒险者的安全很重要，因为新委托中有很多危险任务。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
Hmm...
[Gelkah]
I hope you didn't peek. The Assessment for your capability of standard requests is almost done.
scripts.translation: 希望你没偷看。关于你是否能胜任常规委托的评估快结束了。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
No time to make ^ff0000The badge of advanced Eden Group.^000000
scripts.translation: 没时间制作^ff0000高级乐园团徽章。^000000

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
^ff0000Time is money novice!^000000
I think that's what a true master would sound like right?
scripts.translation: 我觉得真正的师父就该这么说，对吧？

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
{0} will make a request list for you so go talk to my Master now and show your respects.
scripts.translation: {0}会为你整理一份委托清单，现在去找我的师父，向他问好吧。

scripts.text: Haven't found 50 Brigan yet? Master says that it's such a simple task...
scripts.translation: 还没找到50个布里刊吗？师父说这任务很简单啊...

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please hurry up! We need a real adventurer to perform the request.
scripts.translation: 快点！我们需要一位真正的冒险者来完成委托。

scripts.text: Wait a minute. I am making a request list. I just do not know which one I have to give to you. I am a good man.
scripts.translation: 等一下，我正在整理委托清单，只是不知道该给你哪一份。我可是个好人。

scripts.text: The request list is ready. Do you want to start?
scripts.translation: 委托清单已经准备好了。要开始吗？

scripts.text: Hunting Quests
Inquire regards
Show kindness pass
[Gelkah]
You don't need to take all requests at once. Choose a request area that suits your particular skills. One that enables you to perform the request and enjoy the trip at the same time.
scripts.translation: 不用一次接下所有委托。选择适合自己能力的区域，这样既能完成任务，也能享受旅程。

scripts.text: Glastheim related request
scripts.translation: 格拉斯特海姆相关委托

scripts.text: Ash Vacuum related request
Ice Dungeon related request
Magma Dungeon related request
Other requests
[Gelkah]
Here are the requests from the Glastheim area.
scripts.translation: 这是格拉斯特海姆地区的委托。

scripts.text: Carat Hunting
Arclouse Hunting
Anolian Hunting
Sting Hunting
Majoruros Hunting
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. It is important that you rest for a while. There will always be a requests waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托，最好休息一会儿。之后还会有新的委托等着你。

scripts.text: This request is to clear ^0000FF30^000000 ^FF0000Carat^000000 inside of Glastheim castle's first floor.
scripts.translation: 请在格拉斯特海姆城堡一楼清除^0000FF30^000000只^FF0000卡拉特小丑^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've completed the request.
Visiting to scary old castle must be tough. I am sure it would be a good experience for me someday.
scripts.translation: 去那座吓人的古堡探险一定很辛苦。我相信有一天我也能获得不错的经验。

scripts.text: This request is from a merchant from Morocc who is somehow losing business from these monsters in Glastheim.
scripts.translation: 这是梦罗克一位商人的委托，因为这些魔物在格拉斯特海姆抢了他的生意。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Eden Group is aware that this is not a great reason but a request is a request. So please clear ^FF000030 Carat^000000 monsters inside of Glastheim castle.
scripts.translation: 乐园团知道这个理由不算充分，但既然有人委托，我们就得完成。请清除格拉斯特海姆城堡里的^FF000030只卡拉特小丑^000000。

scripts.text: You just finished a request. Please take a rest. There will always be a request for you.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。请休息一下，以后还有委托等着你。

scripts.text: Please clear ^FF000022 Arclouse^000000.
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
You did a great job.
Do you know there are beans used as food here in Midgard? When an Arclouse rolls, it resembles a bean.
scripts.translation: 你知道米德加尔特有一种豆子可以吃吗？卷甲虫蜷起来的时候，看上去就像一颗豆子。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Eden Group Headquarters wants to investigate the Arclouse as a possible mascot.
scripts.translation: 乐园团总部想调查卷甲虫，看看能不能把它选作吉祥物。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000022 Arclouse^000000.
[Gelkah]
That is too bad. It was an interesting request.
scripts.translation: 真可惜，这是个挺有意思的委托。

scripts.text: You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too. There will always be a request waiting for.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。冒险固然重要，休息也一样重要。之后还会有委托等着你。

scripts.text: A monk is on a pilgrimage and seeks protection against some alligator-like creatures.
scripts.translation: 一名僧侣正在朝圣，希望有人保护他免受鳄鱼般的魔物袭击。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Anyways, this request is to clear out Anolians in underground waterway to make way for a safe pilgrimage.
scripts.translation: 总之，这项委托是清除地下水道里的虎蜥人，为朝圣者开辟安全道路。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
You fared well with this request.
Glastheim seems to be a good sacred place not only to adventurers but also to monks. I have no idea what really attracts them there.
scripts.translation: 格拉斯特海姆似乎不只是冒险者的圣地，也是僧侣的圣地。我不知道那里究竟有什么吸引他们。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
A Pilgrimage from the monastery to the underground waterway is a journey. The request is to clear ^FF000030 Anolian^000000 in the Glastheim sewer for a safe pilgrimage.
scripts.translation: 从修道院前往地下水道朝圣也是一段旅程。为了让朝圣者平安通行，请清除格拉斯特海姆下水道里的^FF000030只虎蜥人^000000。

scripts.text: You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too. There will always be a request waiting for.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。冒险固然重要，休息也一样重要。之后还会有委托等着你。

scripts.text: There are many Sting monsters in the underground waterway and underground cave so it will be easy to clear.
scripts.translation: 地下水道和地下洞窟里有很多史汀，清除起来应该不难。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
The request is to clear ^FF000030 Sting^000000 in underground waterway and underground cave for a safe pilgrimage.
scripts.translation: 为了让朝圣者平安通行，请清除地下水道和地下洞窟里的^FF000030只史汀^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Visiting to filthy and smelly underground must be tough. It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation: 去又脏又臭的地下探险一定很辛苦。这会成为不错的经历。

scripts.text: Have you heard about a monk's pilgrimage? There are so many Stings in the underground waterway and cave so they disturb the peaceful monks.
scripts.translation: 听说过僧侣朝圣的事吗？地下水道和洞窟里有很多史汀，会打扰僧侣的清修。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Master accepted this request because he respects those monks. The request is to clear ^FF000030 Sting^000000 monsters in underground waterway for a safe pilgrimage.
scripts.translation: 师父敬重那些僧侣，所以接受了这份委托。为确保他们平安朝圣，请清除地下水道里的^FF000030只史汀^000000。

scripts.text: You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too. Pilgrimage will be continued so there will be another request again.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。朝圣还会继续，之后也会有新的任务。冒险固然重要，休息也一样重要。

scripts.text: I wonder what the reason is behind these monk pilgrimages and why they keep doing it... There must be a hidden reason.
scripts.translation: 我很好奇这些僧侣为何朝圣，以及他们为何坚持这样做...背后一定有隐情。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
I used to take care of the request but I am worried. The request is to clear ^FF000030 Majoruros^000000 from the 2nd floor of the underground cave.
scripts.translation: 我以前负责这份委托，但一直很担心。请清除地下洞窟二楼的^FF000030只狂暴米诺斯^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Visiting for a long pilgrimage must be tiring.
It would be a good experience for you.
The monk's pilgrimage destination is on the 2nd floor of the Glastheim castle underground cave. It is not an easy journey but will be a good experience.
scripts.translation: 僧侣朝圣的目的地是格拉斯特海姆城堡地下洞窟二楼。路途不轻松，但会是很好的历练。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Majoururos is not easy to hunt so be careful. The request is to clear ^FF000030 Majoruros^000000 in the underground cave second floor.
scripts.translation: 狂暴米诺斯很难对付，小心点。请清除地下洞窟二楼的^FF000030只狂暴米诺斯^000000。

scripts.text: There are many requests coming through from the Midgard Expedition.
scripts.translation: 米德加尔特远征队送来了很多委托。

scripts.text: Hunting Quests
Trauma
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too. Please take a rest. There will always be a request for you.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。冒险固然重要，休息也一样重要。请休息一下，之后还有委托等着你。

scripts.text: Outbound space is mysterious.. Monsters are unique.
scripts.translation: 异世界真神秘...魔物也很特别。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
This is an unusual request. Please clear ^FF000030 Pinguicula^000000.
scripts.translation: 这份委托很特别。请清除^FF000030只捕虫堇^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Visiting the Ash Vacuum must be tough.
scripts.translation: 前往灰烬之地一定很辛苦。

scripts.text: It would be a good experience for you.
Pinguicula is one of the first monsters that adventurers encounter when they step into the Ash Vacuum. They expect us to reduce monsters around the Expedition Camp.
scripts.translation: 捕虫堇是冒险者踏入灰烬之地后遇到的第一批魔物之一。远征队希望我们减少营地周边的魔物。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
It is natural to have more accidents with new monsters. It is a common request. Please clear ^FF000030 Pinguicula^000000.
scripts.translation: 有了新魔物，发生意外的概率自然会上升。这是很常见的委托。请清除^FF000030只捕虫堇^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too. Please take a rest. This request is not worth working so hard.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。冒险固然重要，休息也一样重要。请休息一下，不必为了这项委托太拼命。

scripts.text: This is a strange request and a strange reason but we should accept it anyway.
scripts.translation: 委托内容和理由都很奇怪，不过我们还是接下吧。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000030 Luciola Vespa^000000.
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
It must be very tough to do such a strange request.
scripts.translation: 做这种奇怪的委托一定很辛苦。

scripts.text: This is a very personal request. It is unusual but this request is from an adventurer who is friendly with Rohtert.. It is requested by Pretty Boy. Why did he write this?
scripts.translation: 这是一份非常私人的委托。虽然很奇怪，但委托人是罗特特的朋友，也就是“美少年”。他为什么要写这份委托？

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
It is too personal that he got stung by a bee when he was young. It traumatized him so he can't travel to Ash Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 他小时候被蜜蜂蜇过，留下了心理阴影，所以无法前往灰烬之地。

scripts.text: Gelkah is staring at Rohtert.
[Gelkah]
This seems to be a request for increased travelers to the new world. Please clear ^FF000030 Luciola Vespa^000000.
scripts.translation: 这份委托是为了增加前往新世界的旅客。请清除^FF000030只鲁修拉黄蜂^000000。

scripts.text: There are many request near or in the Ice Dungeon in Rachel.
scripts.translation: 拉赫的冰冻地下城附近有很多委托。

scripts.text: Desert Wolf Hunting
Snowier Hunting
Ice Titans...
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。冒险固然重要，休息也一样重要。

scripts.text: Have you read old books? That is about an adventurer who was fighting with big wolves and it ended up with a friendship. It's called Samba's with Wolves.
scripts.translation: 你读过那本旧书吗？书里讲一个冒险者与大狼战斗，最后和它们成了朋友。书名叫《与狼共舞》。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
A novel is a novel. Please clear ^FF000030 Desert Wolf^000000 near the entrance to the Ice dungeon in Rachel.
scripts.translation: 小说终究是小说。请在拉赫冰冻地下城入口附近清除^FF000030只沙漠之狼^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Wasn't that cute?
It would be a good experience for you.
The Ice cave is directly north of Rachel. The problem is that the Wolves frighten tourists when they are heading to see the Ice cave.
scripts.translation: 冰洞就在拉赫正北方。问题是狼群吓到了前往冰洞观光的游客。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
It would be fun if we can talk and samba with wolves! Please clear ^FF000030 Desert Wolf^000000 near Ice dungeon.
scripts.translation: 要是能和狼群一起聊天跳舞就好了！请清除冰冻地下城附近的^FF000030只沙漠之狼^000000。

scripts.text: You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。冒险固然重要，休息也一样重要。

scripts.text: Rough breath, insecure eyes, freezing cold.. It is not easy request so get yourself warm.
scripts.translation: 呼吸急促、眼神不安、寒气逼人...这项委托不容易，记得保暖。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000030 Snowier^000000 on the second floor of Ice dungeon.
scripts.translation: 请清除冰冻地下城二楼的^FF000030只雪怪^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Visiting the freezing ice dungeon must be tough.
scripts.translation: 去冰冷的冰冻地下城探险一定很辛苦。

scripts.text: It would be a good experience for you.
People who have been to ice dungeon say there are noisy monsters disturbing their visits. Please clear them if you can put up with it.
scripts.translation: 去过冰冻地下城的人说，那里有吵闹的魔物妨碍他们参观。如果你能忍受，就帮忙清除它们吧。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000030 Snowier^000000 on the second floor of Ice dungeon.
scripts.translation: 请清除冰冻地下城二楼的^FF000030只雪怪^000000。

scripts.text: You just finished a request. Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。冒险固然重要，休息也一样重要。

scripts.text: Please clear ^FF000030 Ice Titan^000000 at the Ice cave.
scripts.translation: 请在冰洞清除^FF000030只寒冰巨人^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Visiting that cold dark cave must be tough.
scripts.translation: 去那座阴冷的洞窟探险一定很辛苦。

scripts.text: It would be a good experience for you.
Have you been to Ice cave north of Rachel? There are monsters called as Ice Titans deep in the dungeon. Scholars want to determine if they are golems or not.
scripts.translation: 你去过拉赫北边的冰洞吗？地下深处有一种叫寒冰巨人的魔物。学者们想确认它们是不是魔像。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
The request is to reduce the number of them for the scholar's safety. Please clear ^FF000030 Ice Titan^000000 at the Ice cave.
scripts.translation: 为了学者的安全，这份委托是减少寒冰巨人的数量。请在冰洞清除^FF000030只寒冰巨人^000000。

scripts.text: There is a request for monster hunts in Magma Dungeon. ^DA26DAPretty girl wanderer^000000 is requesting this from Comodo.
scripts.translation: 有一份熔岩地下城的狩猎委托，来自克魔岛一位^DA26DA浪漫少女^000000。

scripts.text: Nightmare Terror Hunting
Deleter Hunting
[Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Thanks for keeping memory.. but You should take a rest.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。谢谢你留下这段经历...不过也该休息了。

scripts.text: The memory of a girl is important ! Please clear ^FF000030 Nightmare Terror^000000.
scripts.translation: 那位少女的回忆很重要！请清除^FF000030只七彩梦魇^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Consider the memory of others. There is stil abeauty in the world. It would be a good experience for you.
scripts.translation: 请珍惜别人的回忆。世上仍有美好的一面。这会成为不错的经历。

scripts.text: This request is from a client that is sad because the magma dungeon is full of monsters when she came back to return after breaking up with her lover. Apparently, she spent a lot of time with him there and wants some peace.
scripts.translation: 委托人和恋人分手后回来，发现熔岩地下城里全是魔物，因此感到很难过。她以前常和恋人在那里相处，现在只想要一点安宁。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
The memory of a girl is important! Please clear ^FF000030 Nightmare Terror^000000.
scripts.translation: 那位少女的回忆很重要！请清除^FF000030只七彩梦魇^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
You just finished a request. Did you take enough time to cool down? Take enough rest.
scripts.translation: 你刚完成一项委托。冷静下来了吗？好好休息一下吧。

scripts.text: A client showed a wonderful dance to a lover. One day, they were attacked from a Deleter while they are dancing in the magma dungeon.
scripts.translation: 委托人曾为恋人跳了一支美妙的舞。有一天，他们在熔岩地下城跳舞时遭到一只邪恶小恶魔袭击。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
The attack ruined their dance and eventually their relationship because the guy blamed the girl for being attacked.
scripts.translation: 这次袭击毁了他们的舞蹈，也毁了他们的感情，因为男方怪女方害他们被袭击。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Now she blames the Deleters so she has made this request. Please clear ^FF000030 Flying Deleter^000000.
scripts.translation: 现在她把怨气都撒在邪恶小恶魔身上，所以提出了这份委托。请清除^FF000030只飞行邪恶小恶魔^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Eden Group protects love, justice and Midgard! hurrah!
scripts.translation: 乐园团守护爱情、正义与米德加尔特！万岁！

scripts.text: It would be a good memory.
A client showed a wonderful dance to a lover. One day, they were attacked from a Deleter while they are dancing in the magma dungeon.
scripts.translation: 委托人曾为恋人跳了一支美妙的舞。有一天，他们在熔岩地下城跳舞时遭到一只邪恶小恶魔袭击。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
The attack ruined their dance and eventually their relationship because the guy blamed the girl for being attacked.
scripts.translation: 这次袭击毁了他们的舞蹈，也毁了他们的感情，因为男方怪女方害他们被袭击。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Now she blames the Deleters so she has made this request. Please clear ^FF000030 Flying Deleter^000000.
scripts.translation: 现在她把怨气都撒在邪恶小恶魔身上，所以提出了这份委托。请清除^FF000030只飞行邪恶小恶魔^000000。

scripts.text: Here is a list of other requests from all over Midgard.
scripts.translation: 这是米德加尔特各地的其他委托清单。

scripts.text: Loli Ruri Hunting - Niflheim
scripts.translation: 讨伐银月魔女（尼弗海姆）

scripts.text: Medusa Hunting - Comodo
Anubis Hunting - Sphinx
[Gelkah]
I think you should rest a bit. Even adventurers need their rest right?
scripts.translation: 你最好休息一会儿。冒险者也需要休息，对吧？

scripts.text: Eden Group is planning to send a notice that unmature adventurers are not sent to night time requests because it is too dangerous.
scripts.translation: 乐园团打算发出通知，不再派不成熟的冒险者执行夜间委托，因为太危险了。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
I wonder why they are scheming this kind of ^FF0000nonsense^000000... makes me wonder if they even know anything about adventuring.
scripts.translation: 真想知道他们为什么要策划这种^FF0000荒唐事^000000...他们到底懂不懂冒险呢？

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
We should accept this simple request before we start getting even more nonsense ones. Please clear ^FF000030 Loli Ruri^000000 in Niflheim.
scripts.translation: 我们先接下这项简单的委托吧，免得之后又来更多荒唐任务。请在尼芙菲姆清除^FF000030只银月魔女^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Are you mentally wounded? I am happy that you're back safely.
scripts.translation: 你受伤了吗？真高兴你平安回来了。

scripts.text: It would be a good experience for you.
A secret society requested the protection of the Eden Group from the Loli Ruris because they believe that they have mental powers.
scripts.translation: 一个秘密组织认为银月魔女拥有精神力量，因此请求乐园团协助清除它们。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
They said that they would heal Eden Group adventurers who are exhausted in exchange for the request but we're not sure they'll follow through.
scripts.translation: 对方说会替疲惫的乐园团冒险者疗伤，作为完成委托的报酬，但我们不确定他们是否会兑现。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
We should accept the simple request anyways. Please clear ^FF000030 Loli Ruri^000000 in Niflheim.
scripts.translation: 不管怎样，先接下这项简单的委托吧。请在尼芙菲姆清除^FF000030只银月魔女^000000。

scripts.text: Adventure is important but taking a rest is important too.
scripts.translation: 冒险固然重要，休息也一样重要。

scripts.text: I do not know why master likes this kind of request. He also used to say any request is a good request for an adventurer...
scripts.translation: 我不知道师父为什么喜欢这种委托。他以前还说过，冒险者接下任何委托都有好处...

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000030 Medusa^000000 in the western cave of Comodo.
scripts.translation: 请在克魔岛西边的洞窟清除^FF000030只米杜沙^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
How is Comodo beach? Take a look around instead of paying too much attention to the request.
scripts.translation: 克魔岛海滩怎么样？别光顾着委托，也四处看看吧。

scripts.text: It will be a good experience for sure.
scripts.translation: 这肯定会成为不错的经历。

scripts.text: This is a request from a hair designer in Alberta. He wants to know if the snakes on the Medusa's head are really snakes or fancy hair...
scripts.translation: 这是阿尔贝塔一位发型设计师的委托。他想知道米杜沙头上的蛇到底是真蛇，还是奇特的发型...

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Obviously they're snakes but who are we to stamp on this crazy guy's dreams right?
scripts.translation: 当然是蛇啦。不过，我们何必戳破这个怪人的美梦呢？

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
My master accepted this request simply because it was insane. Please clear ^FF000030 Medusa^000000 monster in the west cave of Comodo.
scripts.translation: 师父只是觉得这份委托很荒唐才接下来的。请在克魔岛西边洞窟清除^FF000030只米杜沙^000000。

scripts.text: The request from Sphinx is done. Please take a rest.
scripts.translation: 斯芬克斯的委托完成了。请休息一下。

scripts.text: I shoud investigate about the client by myself but for now please clear ^FF000020 Anubis^000000 on the 4th floor of Sphinx dungeon.
scripts.translation: 我本来该亲自调查委托人，不过现在请先去斯芬克斯地下城四楼清除^FF000020只安毕斯^000000。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared this request.
Sphinx dungeon is such a maze.
scripts.translation: 斯芬克斯地下城真像迷宫。

scripts.text: It would be a good experience for you.
An anonymous client sent a request to help clear monsters in Sphinx dungeon because adventurers hardly visit Morocc anymore. The monsters seem to be running rampant there.
scripts.translation: 一位匿名委托人请求清除斯芬克斯地下城里的魔物，因为如今很少冒险者前往梦罗克。那里的魔物似乎越来越猖獗。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please clear ^FF000020 Anubis^000000 on the 4th floor of Sphinx dungeon.
scripts.translation: 请在斯芬克斯地下城四楼清除^FF000020只安毕斯^000000。

scripts.text: We are so busy taking requests that need to be taken care of. It is my first time handling so much pressure.
scripts.translation: 要处理的委托实在太多了，我第一次感受到这么大的压力。

scripts.text: I thought Eden Group was busy but I could not imagine it is this much. I should do more as an adventurer!
scripts.translation: 我知道乐园团很忙，但没想到会忙成这样。我也该多尽一份冒险者的责任！

scripts.text: I wish I could have a glass of fresh fruit juice...
Adventurers sometimes bring special things or trophies from where they visited for a request. It is very good!
scripts.translation: 有时冒险者会带回委托地点的特产或战利品，真不错！

scripts.text: If there is something good {0} I will try to give you a couple things. I am not sure if there will be enough to give because of so many adventurers.
scripts.translation: 如果有好东西，{0}我会分你一些。不过冒险者太多，也不知道够不够。

scripts.text: Handling documents must be difficult. It's so much easier to just be out in the field.
scripts.translation: 处理文件肯定很辛苦，还是在外面跑腿轻松多了。

scripts.text: I will let you know if there is something good.
scripts.translation: 要是有好东西，我会告诉你的。

scripts.text: Are you get used to the requests? It is weird that I am guiding adventurers instead of taking requests myself.
scripts.translation: 你习惯这些委托了吗？真奇怪，以前是我自己接任务，现在却变成我在指导冒险者。

scripts.text: It will be good if you clear one at a time after receiving all the requests from Glastheim.
scripts.translation: 把格拉斯特海姆的委托都接下来后，一件一件完成就好。

scripts.text: I am busy but clearing a lot of requests {0} I appreciate it. Lets see. I got some good food from an adventurer that he received during a request.
scripts.translation: 我很忙，不过你完成了这么多委托，{0}我很感激。让我想想，有位冒险者把委托时得到的好吃的东西送给了我。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Oops I ate all? Okay just one left. Please drop by later!
scripts.translation: 糟糕，我全吃光了？好吧，还剩一个。过阵子再来！

scripts.text: Cheer up! {0} I'm not sure if he thinks of you as his pupil. He is just out of control.
scripts.translation: 振作点！{0}我也不知道他是不是把你当学生。他只是有点失控。

scripts.text: There are a lot of presents coming in whenever the requests are done efficiently. Here, take this as a prize.
scripts.translation: 大家高效率地完成委托后，礼物就会送来不少。来，这个给你当奖品。

scripts.text: It is tough work but also fun to with master right {0}?
scripts.translation: 工作很辛苦，不过和师父一起做也挺有趣的，对吧，{0}？

scripts.text: I hate that hot-tempered fool.
scripts.translation: 我讨厌那个急性子的笨蛋。

scripts.text: I want you to be the master.
I would follow you to any battle.
scripts.translation: 不管什么战斗，我都会跟着你。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
I understand you. I got into a fight when I first met master in Mora village.
scripts.translation: 我懂你。我第一次在穆拉村见师父时，也和他打了一架。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
He was almost crying when I first met him. It was difficult to pretend to lose to him. Please keep it a secret.
scripts.translation: 我第一次见他时，他几乎要哭了。假装输给他还真不容易，千万替我保密。

scripts.text: I'm not sure if I'm cut out for that job. Besides...
scripts.translation: 我不确定自己适不适合那份工作。而且...

scripts.text: I am sorry to say this but I am the only pupil of master now and forever... He said ^FF0000I don't need an ugly female pupil^000000 but I still stick to him.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉这么说，但我现在、将来都只会有师父这一个学生...他说^FF0000“我不需要丑女学生”^000000，可我还是赖着不走。

scripts.text: Oh no... Please don't do that. I am sorry please keep it as a secret to a master. I was careless.
scripts.translation: 糟了...别这样。对不起，请替我向师父保密。我刚才说漏嘴了。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Good luck on the remained requests.
scripts.translation: 祝你顺利完成剩下的委托。

scripts.text: Good luck on the remained request. ^FF0000Master says he has something to say to you.^000000
scripts.translation: 祝你顺利完成剩下的委托。^FF0000师父有话要对你说。^000000

scripts.text: I am sorry but I am a little bit busy. Can we talk later?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在有点忙。晚点再聊好吗？

scripts.text: Did you bring the kindness pass?
The ^FF0000kindness pass^000000?
Exchange pass for prizes.
[Gelkah]
I know it sounds childish. Right? The shape is just like the card we used to play when we were kids.
scripts.translation: 我知道听起来很幼稚，对吧？形状就像我们小时候玩的卡片。

scripts.text: A card? What is it?
Uh, yeah those were fun...
scripts.translation: 呃，是啊，那些还挺好玩的...

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
I am sorry... It must be popular only in our village. Throw, heat and let it fly it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉...这大概只有我们村里流行。把它扔出去、加热，再让它飞起来。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
As you see, master made it himself and put his picture on it. He used to travel aroung for looking for the paper material to make the card.
scripts.translation: 你看，这可是师父亲手做的，还印了他的照片。他以前到处旅行，寻找制作卡片的纸张材料。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
If they were not filed properly, the request of looking for a paper will be included to the request list.
scripts.translation: 如果这些资料没有妥善归档，寻找纸张的委托就会出现在委托清单里。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
He is very kind even though he doesn't look like it. Master used it to give something to adventurers for their devotion.
scripts.translation: 师父看起来不像好人，其实很善良。他会用这个把东西送给努力帮忙的冒险者。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Give the story about adventure or trophy by using 1,10,20 and 30 cards.
scripts.translation: 用1、10、20或30张卡片讲述冒险故事，或展示战利品。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
It will be agood experience if you listen to the story of adventurer. There are so much adventure that we heard from a master.
scripts.translation: 听冒险者讲故事也很有趣，还能获得不错的经验。师父讲过很多冒险故事。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
If you are matured enough not to need a request Make sure that you are not allowed to use a pass.
scripts.translation: 如果你的实力已经足以应付委托，就不能再使用通行证了。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
How do you want to use this pass?
scripts.translation: 你想怎么使用这张通行证？

scripts.text: Exchange for prizes
Listen to a story and get EXP
[Gelkah]
You can pick a trophy in this bag. Please do not be disappointed even if you picked up something you do not want. How many do you want to exchange?
scripts.translation: 你可以从这个袋子里挑一件战利品。就算抽到不喜欢的东西，也别失望。你想兑换几件？

scripts.text: Exchange kindness ^FF00001^000000 pass
Exchange kindness ^FF000010^000000 pass
[Gelkah]
Please give me a pass and put your hand in a bag to pick.
scripts.translation: 把通行证给我，然后把手伸进袋子里抽奖吧。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
^FF0000Kindness pass^000000 is insufficient.
browsing
You reach into the bag and grab ^0000FF{0} {1}^000000.
[Gelkah]
Make good use of it.
[Gelkah]
Ok, I've got a story for you in exchange for the kindness pass.
scripts.translation: 好，我来讲个故事，作为善意通行证的回礼。

scripts.text: Give ^FF000010^000000 kindness pass
Give ^FF000020^000000 kindness pass
Give ^FF000030^000000 kindness pass
[Gelkah]
You don't have enough kindness passes.
Have you seen the sunken ship near Alberta?
scripts.translation: 你看过阿尔贝塔附近的沉船吗？

scripts.text: Master Rohter and I traveled deep into the ship and battled a monster known as ^FF0000Drake^000000. That day I was determined that I would be the best adventurer.
scripts.translation: 我和师父罗特特曾深入沉船，与名为^FF0000海盗之王^000000的魔物交战。那天我下定决心，要成为最出色的冒险者。

scripts.text: One time, master and I went to the cave west of Comodo and when we saw the Medusa monster...
scripts.translation: 有一次，我和师父去了克魔岛西边的洞窟，结果看到了米杜沙魔物...

scripts.text: Oh boy the look on his face was priceless!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，他当时的表情真是绝了！

scripts.text: I once got lost in a maze north of Prontera. I thought I was going in circles forever until I finally made it out.
scripts.translation: 我曾在普隆德拉北边的迷宫里迷路，以为自己永远在绕圈，最后总算走了出来。

scripts.text: Rumor has it that if you get lost in that maze you'll turn into one of the monsters there.
scripts.translation: 传闻说，在那座迷宫里迷路的话，就会变成里面的魔物。

scripts.text: You don't have enough kindness passes.
Once I found a secret route to get to Jawaii... It's only for couples but some of us know how to get there still.
scripts.translation: 有一次，我发现一条通往爪哇的秘密路线...只有情侣才能走，不过我们当中还是有人知道怎么去。

scripts.text: Kind of useless to be there without a partner but oh well.
scripts.translation: 没有伴侣的话，去那里也没什么意思，不过算了。

scripts.text: So one time, master was part of a guild called wing something... Chicken wing...?
scripts.translation: 有一次，师父加入了一个叫什么翅膀的公会...鸡翅膀？

scripts.text: It was a fun guild because no one took things seriously but master got tired of their laziness so he left.
scripts.translation: 那公会挺有意思的，没人把事情当回事。不过师父受不了他们懒散的样子，就离开了。

scripts.text: Have you been up to ^FF0000endless tower^000000? Master and I went there but only got to the 20th floor because his knee gave out while climbing...
scripts.translation: 你去过^FF0000无限塔^000000吗？我和师父去过，但爬到20楼时他的膝盖就不行了...

scripts.text: ^FF0000Endless tower^000000 is somewhere in the sea. You have to find a guy named Jansor or Jans-something in Alberta and he'll sail you there.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000无尽之塔^000000在海上的某处。去艾尔贝塔找一个叫扬索尔，或什么扬什么的人，他会带你过去。

scripts.text: You don't have enough kindness passes.
Master's guild was dismissed at the Ash Vacuum because their guild master went missing after a battle with some Cornus monsters.
scripts.translation: 师父的公会在灰烬之地解散了，因为他们的会长在与飞马交战后失踪。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Ever since then he started being mean to weaker adventurers...
scripts.translation: 从那以后，他开始欺负比自己弱的冒险者...

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
I don't think he ever saw that guild master again after that day.
scripts.translation: 我想那天之后，他再也没见过那位公会会长。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Master started out as a popular support Monk at the Prontera monastery.
scripts.translation: 师父最初是在普隆德拉修道院里颇受欢迎的支援型僧侣。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
But he was also regarded as a troublemaker because of his competitive nature so he left.
scripts.translation: 不过，他好胜心强，也被视为麻烦人物，所以后来离开了。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
Please come back to me if you are received more kindness passes!
scripts.translation: 如果你拿到更多善意通行证，记得来找我！

scripts.text: {0}! You did a good job! There are more requests but reserve them for the other adventurers.
scripts.translation: {0}！你做得很好！还有其他委托，不过留给别的冒险者吧。

scripts.text: I do not think you are suitable to the request I can give. Please find other adventures.
scripts.translation: 我觉得你不适合接我能提供的委托。去找别的冒险者吧。

scripts.text: Accept the request.
Decline.
[Gelkah]
Please inform me when you've cleared the request.
[Gelkah]
The journey to the lowest floor of Glastheim is a long trip but it can be fun if you go with a party.
scripts.translation: 前往格拉斯特海姆最底层要走很久，不过和队伍一起去会很有趣。

scripts.text: [Gelkah]
You completed the request
I will mark you down as having completed this request.
scripts.translation: 我会把你记录为已完成这项委托。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
You are not even a member of Eden Group. What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你甚至不是乐园团成员，来这里做什么？

scripts.text: I'm only dealing with base level ^FF0000100 - 110^000000 adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我只接待基础等级^FF0000100～110^000000的冒险者。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
Such a novice... go and train yourself more. What? Don't like the way I talk? Then get stronger.
scripts.translation: 真是个菜鸟...回去多练练吧。什么？不喜欢我说话的方式？那就变强吧。

scripts.text: You are a little bit too mature of an adventurer. You have no business with me. Just leave. My business is with new third class adventurers up to level 110.
scripts.translation: 你已经是个太老练的冒险者了，不需要来找我。快走吧。我要找的是基础等级不超过110级的新三转冒险者。

scripts.text: Yeah waddya want from me kid? You think I'm just gonna say ok I'll be your master and teach you everything I know?
scripts.translation: 喂，小鬼，你想从我这儿得到什么？你以为我会直接说“好，我当你师父，把本事全教给你”？

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
I'm not a charity so get lost.
You a new adventurer?
[Rohtert]
There are so much things to do and you're wasting your time with me. Talk to Gelkah she's more chatty than I'll ever be to you.
scripts.translation: 有那么多事情要做，你却浪费时间跟我闲聊。去找盖尔卡，她比我健谈得多。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
You seem brave enough to be a good adventurer but you're nothing but a Novice in my eyes.
scripts.translation: 你看起来有成为优秀冒险者的胆量，但在我眼里你还是个新手。

scripts.text: I used to an adventurer for the Eden Group just like you but of course I was the best.
scripts.translation: 我以前也像你一样是乐园团的冒险者，当然，我可是最优秀的。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
I guess I'm retired now because my adventuring skills are just too good to compete with all you kids.
scripts.translation: 我想我现在退休了，毕竟我的冒险本领太强，你们这些小鬼根本比不过。

scripts.text: Anyway, I'm doing this a favor to the Eden Group.
scripts.translation: 总之，我这是在帮乐园团的忙。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
I am looking for someone who regards friendship or loyalty like a Spoon Stub.
scripts.translation: 我在找一个把友情或忠诚看得比老旧汤匙还重要的人。

scripts.text: A Spoon what?
You're a bad person.
[Rohtert]
You know? A Spoon Stub. Zombie Prisoners drop them and they seem like they're usefull but really they're kinda worthless.
scripts.translation: 老旧汤匙，你懂吧？僵尸囚犯会掉落。看起来挺有用，其实没什么价值。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
Anyway, I guess you seem like the loyal type... sort of...
scripts.translation: 总之，我觉得你还算忠诚...大概吧...

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
That makes me feel weird. That is not bad but I guess I'm bad and I don't care.
scripts.translation: 真让我不自在。倒也不坏，不过我这人就是不在乎。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
Remember to stay brave you silly adventurer.
scripts.translation: 记住要勇敢一点，你这个傻冒险者。

scripts.text: Okay ! You are doing the best that you can do.
[Rohtert]
I am afraid if you are becoming like Gelkah. She's like a lost puppy. Don't be like her. Okay?
scripts.translation: 我担心你会变得和盖尔卡一样。她像只迷路的小狗，可别学她，知道吗？

scripts.text: You busy looking all around.
[Rohtert]
I am done with my business.
I am responsible for clearing documents. I hate doing this stuff.
scripts.translation: 我负责整理文件，真讨厌这些工作。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
I guess I should talk to him one more time... Come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation: 我想我该再跟他说一次...明天再来！

scripts.text: Oh, how long has it been?
White is a paper and black is a letters. I hate public documents. But, I have to do this so I am busy for a while.
scripts.translation: 白纸黑字的，我最讨厌公开文件了。不过我得处理一下，暂时没空。

scripts.text: I know that hunting the Tens Drillion can't be too difficult for you.
scripts.translation: 我想狩猎十头龙对你来说不难。

scripts.text: Good ! You are becoming a good adventurer! Do your best!
scripts.translation: 很好！你越来越像个出色的冒险者了！继续努力！

scripts.text: Tens Drillion I think we should teach it more lessons to show it who's boss!
scripts.translation: 十头龙，我看得再好好教训你一顿，让你知道谁才是老大！

scripts.text: Lets give a good lesson for sure.
scripts.translation: 这次一定要好好教训它。

scripts.text: I think once is enough.
[Rohtert]
It is fine there are still many adventurers that can do this.
scripts.translation: 没关系，还有很多冒险者能完成这件事。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
It is not because I am coward.
scripts.translation: 我可不是因为胆小才这样。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
Good luck. Make sure you finish it off this time. Hah hah!
scripts.translation: 祝你好运，这次记得彻底解决它。哈哈！

scripts.text: You still there novice? If you can't handle this by yourself then ask your friends because this is not the easiest thing to do.
scripts.translation: 你还在这儿啊，新手？自己应付不了就找朋友帮忙，这可不是简单的任务。

scripts.text: Oh you're back safely!
I guess you're not a scrub like I thought you were.
scripts.translation: 看来你不是我想象中的菜鸟。

scripts.text: Do you mind doing a simple errand?
No I don't mind!
Simple errands are for simpletons.
scripts.translation: 这种简单差事只有笨蛋才会做。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
You are a strange adventurer...
scripts.translation: 你真是个奇怪的冒险者...

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
One fine windy day, I was collecting flowers in west south of the Midgard Allied Forces Post to fulfill an Eden Group request.
scripts.translation: 某个风和日丽的日子，我为了完成乐园团委托，在米德加尔特联合军营地西南方采花。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
Then that one suddenly showed up.
scripts.translation: 接着，那家伙突然出现了。

scripts.text: One what?
[Rohtert]
It was a ^FF0000Tens Drillion.^000000
Oops! Its actually ^FF0000Tendrilion^000000!! Master!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！其实是^FF0000藤狮龙^000000！！师父！

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
Yeah yeah potato po-tah-toh!
scripts.translation: 好啦好啦，土豆、马铃薯，差不多嘛！

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
We realized when we faced the eyes of the beast that it looked like a lion but it isn't any normal animal.
scripts.translation: 我们直视那头野兽的双眼时才发现，它看起来像狮子，却不是普通的动物。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
^8008F8I knew that it was kill or be killed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^8008F8我知道那是一场你死我活的战斗。^000000

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
Of course I beat that beast easily! It was easier than taking candy from a Poring.
scripts.translation: 当然是我轻松打败了那头野兽！比从波利手里抢糖还简单。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
But to my surprise, the beast got back up. I was forced to beat it down 12 more times before it stayed down. This was not a normal Tens Drillion.
scripts.translation: 没想到那头野兽又站了起来。我只好再打倒它12次，它才终于不动了。这可不是普通的藤狮。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
I heard it is still wandering place to palce but I am kind of busy now.
scripts.translation: 听说它还在四处游荡，不过我现在有点忙。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
I want you to take care of it. For me it was fine to be there alone. But for you.. I recommend you to bring more adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我想请你去处理它。我一个人去都没问题，但你嘛...最好多找些冒险者同行。

scripts.text: You sure you did this yourself?
scripts.translation: 你确定是你自己一个人解决的？

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
The fact that I am strong is more important than the number. Just go there and take the beast out.
scripts.translation: 重要的是我的实力，不是人数。你只管去把那头野兽解决掉。

scripts.text: [Rohtert]
You'll find it west of the Midgard Allied Forces Post at the Ash Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 它就在灰烬之地、米德加尔特联合军营地的西边。

scripts.text: I guess I have no choice.
[Rohtert]
You still there novice? If you can not handle by yourself then ask to your friends because it is not easy one.
scripts.translation: 你还在这儿啊，新手？自己应付不了就找朋友帮忙，这可不简单。

scripts.text: If you find it don't be scared. Master did not have to fight the Tendrilion 12 times.
scripts.translation: 找到它时别害怕。师父并没有和藤狮龙打12次才打赢。

scripts.text: In fact, master was so drunk he barely remembers the thing.
scripts.translation: 其实师父当时喝醉了，几乎什么都不记得。

scripts.text: I just left it alone because it was a little bit cute that a master was fighting with one Tendrilion. Now its becoming a problem.
scripts.translation: 我只是觉得师父和一头藤狮龙打架的样子有点可爱，才放着不管。现在可麻烦了。

scripts.text: Please come back after clearing one Tendrilion. Oh and please keep this a secret from master.
scripts.translation: 打倒一头藤狮龙后再回来。还有，别把这件事告诉师父。
